Search request with max_results parameter limiting response count

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\SearchRequest;

query: "Rust programming",
maxResults: 2));
```
